title: Westlaw (research)
description: Case law from Thomson Reuters' Westlaw as a research source on legal topics, declared as a service: its request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Needs Thomson Reuters API access. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: legal, criminal_justice), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; research and Web Search list it by this name.

config.name: api_key
config.label: Westlaw API token
config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
